title: Full-Day Beach Day at Grand Bend
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: This destination in Ontario is an absolute must-visit for any traveler seeking respite from the summer heat. Its emerald waters and breathtaking beach are simply unparalleled, and the range of shops and restaurants on offer make it the perfect spot for socializing and dining. Notably, it has earned the prestigious Blue Flag certification, signifying the highest quality of water and the most tranquil atmosphere. For anyone looking for a fun-filled day with family, this spot is an optimal choice. The journey to reach this beautiful location is divided into three parts, totaling eleven hours: 2 and a half hours to get to the beach, 5 and a half hours to bask in the beauty of the surroundings, and 2 and a half hours to return to Toronto.
